{\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n    }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CeirastKyv875PhAfQveR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Eim5p2Zyr5zTR9kX8gUGHs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/cholesky_claude-fable-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Hybrid parallel Cholesky decomposition (MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Block rows of A are distributed 1D block-cyclically across MPI ranks;\n//    each rank drives one GPU (round-robin over the GPUs of its node).\n//  - Right-looking blocked algorithm: the diagonal block is factorized on the\n//    host with OpenMP, the panel below it is solved with a CUDA TRSM kernel,\n//    the panel is allgathered across ranks, and the trailing submatrix is\n//    updated with a tiled CUDA GEMM kernel on each rank's GPU.\n//  - OpenMP additionally parallelizes matrix generation staging, panel\n//    packing/unpacking, and validation on the host.\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                         \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block size for the distributed blocked algorithm\nconstexpr int NB = 256;\n\nstatic int g_rank = 0;\nstatic int g_nranks = 1;\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Tiled GEMM: C (M x N) op= A (M x K) * B (N x K)^T, all row-major.\n// MODE 0: C = A * B^T   (used for matrix generation)\n// MODE 1: C -= A * B^T  (used for the trailing update)\ntemplate <int MODE>\n__global__ void gemm_nt_kernel(int M, int N, int K,\n                               const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                               const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                               double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc) {\n    constexpr int BM = 64, BN = 64, BK = 16, TM = 4, TN = 4;\n    __shared__ double sA[BK][BM];\n    __shared__ double sB[BK][BN];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x; // 0..15\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y; // 0..15\n    const int tid = ty * 16 + tx;\n    const int rowBase = blockIdx.y * BM;\n    const int colBase = blockIdx.x * BN;\n\n    double acc[TM][TN] = {};\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += BK) {\n        for (int t = tid; t < BM * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int i = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = rowBase + i, c = k0 + kk;\n            sA[kk][i] = (r < M && c < K) ? A[(size_t)r * lda + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        for (int t = tid; t < BN * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int j = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = colBase + j, c = k0 + kk;\n            sB[kk][j] = (r < N && c < K) ? B[(size_t)r * ldb + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < BK; ++kk) {\n            double a[TM], b[TN];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) a[i] = sA[kk][ty * TM + i];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) b[j] = sB[kk][tx * TN + j];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i)\n                #pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j)\n                    acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) {\n        const int r = rowBase + ty * TM + i;\n        if (r >= M) continue;\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) {\n            const int c = colBase + tx * TN + j;\n            if (c >= N) continue;\n            if (MODE == 0)\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] = acc[i][j];\n            else\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] -= acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <int MODE>\nstatic void launch_gemm_nt(int M, int N, int K,\n                           const double* A, size_t lda,\n                           const double* B, size_t ldb,\n                           double* C, size_t ldc) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 threads(16, 16);\n    dim3 blocks((N + 63) / 64, (M + 63) / 64);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<MODE><<<blocks, threads>>>(M, N, K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// TRSM (right, lower, transposed): solve X * L^T = A in place for a panel of\n// M rows and kb columns. One thread per panel row; the row is staged through\n// per-thread local memory so accesses are coalesced across the warp.\n__global__ void trsm_rlt_kernel(int M, int kb,\n                                double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                                const double* __restrict__ L, int ldl) {\n    const int r = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= M) return;\n\n    double x[NB];\n    double* row = X + (size_t)r * ldx;\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) x[j] = row[j];\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n        double s = x[j];\n        for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) s -= x[p] * L[j * ldl + p];\n        x[j] = s / L[j * ldl + j];\n    }\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) row[j] = x[j];\n}\n\n// Add `val` to the diagonal entries of an owned block row: local row t of the\n// block corresponds to global row (gRow0 + t) and thus global column gRow0 + t.\n__global__ void add_diag_kernel(double* __restrict__ Ablock, size_t lda,\n                                int rows, size_t gRow0, double val) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < rows) Ablock[(size_t)t * lda + gRow0 + t] += val;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Block-cyclic distribution helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nblocks = 0;                 // total number of block rows\n    std::vector<int> localBlocks;    // global block indices owned by this rank\n    std::vector<size_t> localOff;    // local row offset of each owned block (+ total)\n    size_t localRows = 0;\n\n    void init(size_t n_) {\n        n = n_;\n        nblocks = (int)((n + NB - 1) / NB);\n        localBlocks.clear();\n        localOff.assign(1, 0);\n        for (int b = g_rank; b < nblocks; b += g_nranks) {\n            localBlocks.push_back(b);\n            localOff.push_back(localOff.back() + blockRows(b));\n        }\n        localRows = localOff.back();\n    }\n\n    size_t blockRows(int b) const {\n        return std::min((size_t)NB, n - (size_t)b * NB);\n    }\n    static int owner(int b) { return b % g_nranks; }\n    // Rows owned by rank r that belong to blocks with global index > k\n    size_t tailRowsOf(int r, int k, size_t n_) const {\n        size_t rows = 0;\n        for (int b = (k + 1) + ((r - (k + 1)) % g_nranks + g_nranks) % g_nranks;\n             b < nblocks; b += g_nranks) {\n            if (b % g_nranks == r) rows += blockRows(b);\n        }\n        (void)n_;\n        return rows;\n    }\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host-side factorization of the diagonal block (OpenMP)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic bool potrfHost(double* D, int kb, int ld, size_t globalOffset) {\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n        double s = D[(size_t)j * ld + j];\n        for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) s -= D[(size_t)j * ld + p] * D[(size_t)j * ld + p];\n        if (s <= 0.0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                   globalOffset + (size_t)j);\n            return false;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(s);\n        D[(size_t)j * ld + j] = d;\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = j + 1; i < kb; ++i) {\n            double t = D[(size_t)i * ld + j];\n            for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) t -= D[(size_t)i * ld + p] * D[(size_t)j * ld + p];\n            D[(size_t)i * ld + j] = t / d;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* dA, const Distribution& dist) {\n    const size_t n = dist.n;\n    const int nblocks = dist.nblocks;\n\n    double* hDiag = nullptr;\n    double* hPanelSend = nullptr;\n    double* hPanelRecv = nullptr;\n    double* hPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hDiag, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelSend, dist.localRows * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelRecv, n * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanel, n * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* dLkk = nullptr;\n    double* dPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLkk, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPanel, (n * NB + 1) * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_nranks), displs(g_nranks);\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    for (int k = 0;                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                         \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block size for the distributed blocked algorithm\nconstexpr int NB = 256;\n\nstatic int g_rank = 0;\nstatic int g_nranks = 1;\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Tiled GEMM: C (M x N) op= A (M x K) * B (N x K)^T, all row-major.\n// MODE 0: C = A * B^T   (used for matrix generation)\n// MODE 1: C -= A * B^T  (used for the trailing update)\ntemplate <int MODE>\n__global__ void gemm_nt_kernel(int M, int N, int K,\n                               const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                               const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                               double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc) {\n    constexpr int BM = 64, BN = 64, BK = 16, TM = 4, TN = 4;\n    __shared__ double sA[BK][BM];\n    __shared__ double sB[BK][BN];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x; // 0..15\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y; // 0..15\n    const int tid = ty * 16 + tx;\n    const int rowBase = blockIdx.y * BM;\n    const int colBase = blockIdx.x * BN;\n\n    double acc[TM][TN] = {};\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += BK) {\n        for (int t = tid; t < BM * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int i = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = rowBase + i, c = k0 + kk;\n            sA[kk][i] = (r < M && c < K) ? A[(size_t)r * lda + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        for (int t = tid; t < BN * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int j = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = colBase + j, c = k0 + kk;\n            sB[kk][j] = (r < N && c < K) ? B[(size_t)r * ldb + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < BK; ++kk) {\n            double a[TM], b[TN];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) a[i] = sA[kk][ty * TM + i];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) b[j] = sB[kk][tx * TN + j];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i)\n                #pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j)\n                    acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) {\n        const int r = rowBase + ty * TM + i;\n        if (r >= M) continue;\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) {\n            const int c = colBase + tx * TN + j;\n            if (c >= N) continue;\n            if (MODE == 0)\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] = acc[i][j];\n            else\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] -= acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <int MODE>\nstatic void launch_gemm_nt(int M, int N, int K,\n                           const double* A, size_t lda,\n                           const double* B, size_t ldb,\n                           double* C, size_t ldc) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 threads(16, 16);\n    dim3 blocks((N + 63) / 64, (M + 63) / 64);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<MODE><<<blocks, threads>>>(M, N, K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// TRSM (right, lower, transposed): solve X * L^T = A in place for a panel of\n// M rows and kb columns. One thread per panel row; the row is staged through\n// per-thread local memory so accesses are coalesced across the warp.\n__global__ void trsm_rlt_kernel(int M, int kb,\n                                double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                                const double* __restrict__ L, int ldl) {\n    const int r = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= M) return;\n\n <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

\"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Hybrid parallel Cholesky decomposition (MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// submatrix is\n//    updated with a tiled CUDA GEMM kernel on each rank's GPU.\n//  - OpenMP additionally parallelizes matrix generation staging, panel\n//    packing/unpacking, and validation on the    \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block size for the distributed blocked algorithm\nconstexpr int NB = 256;\n\nstatic int g_rank = 0;\nstatic int g_nranks = 1;\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// generation)\n// MODE 1: C -= A * B^T  (used for the trailing update)\ntemplate <int MODE>\n__global__ void gemm_nt_kernel(int M, int N, int K,\n                               const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                               const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                               double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc) {\n    constexpr int BM = 64, BN = 64, BK = 16, TM = 4, TN = 4;\n    __shared__ double sA[BK][BM];\n    __shared__ double sB[BK][BN];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x; // 0..15\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y; // 0..15\n    const int tid = ty * 16 + tx;\n    const int rowBase = blockIdx.y * BM;\n    const int colBase = blockIdx.x * BN;\n\n    double acc[TM][TN] = {};\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += BK) {\n        for (int t = tid; t < BM * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int i = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = rowBase + i, c = k0 + kk;\n            sA[kk][i] = (r < M && c < K) ? A[(size_t)r * lda + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        for (int t = tid; t < BN * BK; t += 256) {\n            const int j = t / BK, kk = t % BK;\n            const int r = colBase + j, c = k0 + kk;\n            sB[kk][j] = (r < N && c < K) ? B[(size_t)r * ldb + c] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < BK; ++kk) {\n            double a[TM], b[TN];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) a[i] = sA[kk][ty * TM + i];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) b[j] = sB[kk][tx * TN + j];\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i)\n                #pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j)\n                    acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) {\n        const int r = rowBase + ty * TM + i;\n        if (r >= M) continue;\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) {\n            const int c = colBase + tx * TN + j;\n            if (c >= N) continue;\n            if (MODE == 0)\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] = acc[i][j];\n            else\n                C[(size_t)r * ldc + c] -= acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <int MODE>\nstatic void launch_gemm_nt(int M, int N, int K,\n                           const double* A, size_t lda,\n                           const double* B, size_t ldb,\n                           double* C, size_t ldc) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 threads(16, 16);\n    dim3 blocks((N + 63) / 64, (M + 63) / 64);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<MODE><<<blocks, threads>>>(M, N, K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// TRSM (right, lower, transposed): solve X * L^T = A in place for a panel of\n// M rows and kb columns. One thread per panel row; the row is staged through\n// per-thread local memory so accesses are coalesced across the warp.\n__global__ void trsm_rlt_kernel(int M, int kb,\n                                double* __restrict__ X, size_t ldx,\n                                const double* __restrict__ L, int ldl) {\n    const int r = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= M) return;\n\n    double x[NB];\n    double* row = X + (size_t)r * ldx;\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) x[j] = row[j];\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n        double s = x[j];\n        for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) s -= x[p] * L[j * ldl + p];\n        x[j] = s / L[j * ldl + j];\n    }\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) row[j] = x[j];\n}\n\n// Add `val` to the diagonal entries of an owned block row: local row t of the\n// block corresponds to global row (gRow0 + t) and thus global column gRow0 + t.\n__global__ void add_diag_kernel(double* __restrict__ Ablock, size_t lda,\n                                int rows, size_t gRow0, double val) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (t < rows) Ablock[(size_t)t * lda + gRow0 + t] += val;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Block-cyclic distribution helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Distribution {\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nblocks = 0;                 // total number of block rows\n    std::vector<int> localBlocks;    // global block indices owned by this rank\n    std::vector<size_t> localOff;    // local row offset of each owned block (+ total)\n    size_t localRows = 0;\n\n    void init(size_t n_) {\n        n = n_;\n        nblocks = (int)((n + NB - 1) / NB);\n        localBlocks.clear();\n        localOff.assign(1, 0);\n        for (int b = g_rank; b < nblocks; b += g_nranks) {\n            localBlocks.push_back(b);\n            localOff.push_back(localOff.back() + blockRows(b));\n        }\n        localRows = localOff.back();\n    }\n\n    size_t blockRows(int b) const {\n        return std::min((size_t)NB, n - (size_t)b * NB);\n    }\n    static int owner(int b) { return b % g_nranks; }\n    // Rows owned by rank r that belong to blocks with global index > k\n    size_t tailRowsOf(int r, int k, size_t n_) const {\n        size_t rows = 0;\n        for (int b = (k + 1) + ((r - (k + 1)) % g_nranks + g_nranks) % g_nranks;\n             b < nblocks; b += g_nranks) {\n            if (b % g_nranks == r) rows += blockRows(b);\n        }\n        (void)n_;\n        return rows;\n    }\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host-side factorization of the diagonal block (OpenMP)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic bool potrfHost(double* D, int kb, int ld, size_t globalOffset) {\n    for (int j = 0; j < kb; ++j) {\n        double s = D[(size_t)j * ld + j];\n        for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) s -= D[(size_t)j * ld + p] * D[(size_t)j * ld + p];\n        if (s <= 0.0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\",\n                   globalOffset + (size_t)j);\n            return false;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(s);\n        D[(size_t)j * ld + j] = d;\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = j + 1; i < kb; ++i) {\n            double t = D[(size_t)i * ld + j];\n            for (int p = 0; p < j; ++p) t -= D[(size_t)i * ld + p] * D[(size_t)j * ld + p];\n            D[(size_t)i * ld + j] = t / d;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* dA, const Distribution& dist) {\n    const size_t n = dist.n;\n    const int nblocks = dist.nblocks;\n\n    double* hDiag = nullptr;\n    double* hPanelSend = nullptr;\n    double* hPanelRecv = nullptr;\n    double* hPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hDiag, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelSend, dist.localRows * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelRecv, n * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanel, n * NB * sizeof(double) + sizeof(double)));\n\n    double* dLkk = nullptr;\n    double* dPanel = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLkk, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPanel, (n * NB + 1) * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(g_nranks), displs(g_nranks);\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    for (int k = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CeisK1jHaao6V41vcRdp3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The Cholesky benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation, verified correct across rank counts and matrix sizes, with strong performance and scaling.\n\n## What was changed\n\n**`cholesky/cholesky.cpp`** — rewritten as a distributed, GPU-accelerated blocked right-looking Cholesky (the file is compiled as CUDA; no new files, executable is still `cholesky`):\n\n- **MPI**: block rows (block size 256) are distributed 1D block-cyclically across ranks; each rank binds round-robin to a GPU on its node. Per step, the diagonal-block factor is broadcast, the solved panel is allgathered, and the factor is gathered to rank 0 at the end for output/validation. A non-positive-definite matrix is detected by the owning rank and the failure propagates to all ranks, matching the original error message and exit code.\n- **CUDA**: matrix generation (`A = B·Bᵀ`), the panel triangular solve (custom TRSM kernel, one thread per row staged through coalesced local memory), and the O(n³) trailing update (custom shared-memory tiled DGEMM, 64×64 tiles with 4×4 register blocking) all run on the GPU with the matrix resident in device memory.\n- **OpenMP**: threaded host-side diagonal-block factorization, panel packing/reordering, upper-triangle zeroing, and validation. Threads-per-rank are automatically capped at cores÷(ranks per node) unless `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is set, which avoids the oversubscription that otherwise cripples multi-rank runs.\n\n**`cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`** — enables the CUDA language, compiles `cholesky.cpp` via nvcc (`set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`), and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, and the CUDA runtime. No dependencies beyond MPI/OpenMP/CUDA (not even cuBLAS — the kernels are hand-written).\n\n## Semantics preserved\n\nSame CLI, same output format, same deterministic seed-42 matrix generation, same timing/GFLOPS/validation reporting (rank 0 only). B is generated with the identical sequential `rand_r` stream on every rank; results differ from the sequential build only in floating-point summation order (validation max relative error ~3e-13 at n=512).\n\n## Measured results (4× RTX 3090, validation PASSED in all cases)\n\n| n | 1 rank | 4 ranks |\n|---|---|---|\n| 8192 | 260 GFLOPS | 348 GFLOPS |\n| 16384 | 414 GFLOPS | 778 GFLOPS |\n\nSingle-GPU throughput reaches ~74% of the 3090's FP64 peak, and 4 GPUs give ~1.9× at n=16384 (scaling improves further with matrix size as the trailing update dominates the host-staged panel exchange). Edge cases verified: standalone run without `mpirun`, non-divisible sizes (n=700, 1000), more ranks than blocks (np=5, 3 blocks), and odd rank counts."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":648,"cache_read_input_tokens":48789,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":648},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"35635590-3fe9-4e67-a7ce-d2978ccd2ba6","uuid":"4b5a8ef3-31a5-4876-9446-7cc36452c489","timestamp":"2026-09-04T18:25:20.580Z","request_id":"req_011CeisJzbpi1LEX7SrHPUgT"}

A non-positive-definite matrix is detected by the owning rank and the failure propagates to all ranks, matching the original error message and exit code.\n- **CUDA**: matrix generation (`A = B·Bᵀ`), the panel triangular solve (custom TRSM kernel, one thread per row staged through coalesced local memory), and the O(n³) trailing update (custom shared-memory tiled DGEMM, 64×64 tiles with 4×4 register blocking) all run on the GPU with the matrix resident in device memory.\n- **OpenMP**: threaded host-side diagonal-block factorization, panel packing/reordering, upper-triangle zeroing, and validation. Threads-per-rank are automatically capped at cores÷(ranks per node) unless `OMP_NUM_THREADS` is set, which avoids the oversubscription that otherwise cripples multi-rank runs.\n\n**`cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`** — enables the CUDA language, compiles `cholesky.cpp` via nvcc (`set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`), and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`, `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, and the CUDA runtime. No dependencies beyond MPI/OpenMP/CUDA (not even cuBLAS — the kernels are hand-written).\n\n## Semantics preserved\n\nSame CLI, same output format, same deterministic seed-42 matrix generation, same timing/GFLOPS/validation reporting (rank 0 only). B is generated with the identical sequential `rand_r` stream on every rank; results differ from the sequential build only in floating-point summation order (validation max relative error ~3e-13 at n=512).\n\n## Measured results (4× RTX 3090, validation PASSED in all cases)\n\n| n | 1 rank | 4 ranks |\n|---|---|---|\n| 8192 | 260 GFLOPS | 348 GFLOPS |\n| 16384 | 414 GFLOPS | 778 GFLOPS |\n\nSingle-GPU throughput reaches ~74% of the 3090's FP64 peak, and 4 GPUs give ~1.9× at n=16384 (scaling improves further with matrix size as the trailing update dominates the host-staged panel exchange).
